args.body: Read back the artifacts behind the latest redacted SQLITE-BESPOKE-QUOTE-TERMS receipt through permitted public repository inputs. If the bilingual terms and both fictional intake decisions are committed and meet the goal, close under a current lease with a lesson and the actual file paths. If a check failed or an artifact is missing, fix that specific gap. The operator needs one provisional CAD amount, a buyer-specific verification criterion, and a clear decline condition when the expected result or a correction cannot be verified. Keep the quote private and conditional on operator approval and a real eligible inquiry.
